runs.content: Evertec (EVTC) picked up at the previous close ($29.76) — a LatAm payments/fintech name at ~13.8x P/E near its May 2026 low after a Q1 EPS miss and June data-breach disclosure, but with the Dimensa acquisition now closed, 2026 EPS guidance raised (~9.9%), ~$210M TTM FCF, and analyst targets of $32.60-35.80, chosen away from today's narrow Nvidia/Salesforce/CrowdStrike-driven tech rally to avoid Burry's semiconductor/AI-capex conflict zone. This run follows a 17-day scheduling gap (last run 2026-08-10) — only today was processed, no back-dated trades. MRNA hit T2 (+150.49% @ $149.66) on Moderna's Merck-partnered melanoma vaccine Phase 3 win (announced during the gap) — mechanical tranche sale (~$835), final 1/3 now runs uncapped as the portfolio's largest open gainer. No stop-losses or signal exits. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,745 (+5.49% on $50,000).

Yum China (YUMC) picked up at the previous close ($47.72) — Morningstar flags it 40% undervalued (FV $77), reinforced by a Q2 beat-and-raise (EPS $0.70 vs $0.67 est, revenue +13% YoY) and a fresh multi-analyst buy wave (Citic, Nomura, Jefferies, UOB Kay Hian, Huatai, Guotai Haitong), chosen over CLX (post-earnings double analyst downgrade, PTs below spot) and CPB (deepest discount but structurally challenged category). CMCL hit T1 (+25.50% @ $21.75) and RDW hit T2 (+60.45% @ $13.59) — both mechanical tranche sales, positions remain open. RIVN and MRNA recovered off WATCH; JBHT remains WATCH (−10.02%), no Burry conflict. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,851 (+3.78% on $49,000).
